name: Sara
text: I didn’t think I’d need something as simple as a feeding tracker, but with a newborn I can totally see why this would be helpful. After a few broken nights of sleep, remembering whether the last feed was 30 minutes ago or two hours ago isn’t always as easy as it sounds 😅. I really like that this just lets you record it quickly without making things complicated. Such a thoughtful and practical tool for new moms.
